pro_course_detail.description:
It is no secret that one of the best ways to improve foreign language skills is to read in them as much as possible. In fact, our knowledge of languages can perhaps best be measured in the kilometers of text we’ve read in them!

Literature provides access to a treasure trove of language, which we can use to enrich our own speech, writing and understanding. It provides the absolute best examples of careful and precise language usage, from which we can learn more than any English textbook.

At the same time, reading in a foreign language allows us to discover and explore new worlds. But instead of traveling through space, we travel through text! Reading is, perhaps, the best way to deepen our understanding of other cultures. The universe of literature written in English or translated into this language is boundless, and your journey though it can provide lifelong enjoyment!  

As a teacher of literature, I can help you make reading in English interesting and fun!

All of our sample speaking tests are analyzed by ME and Chat GPT simultaneously then scored individually, and merged into a table to provide you with the most comprehensive scores, assessments, suggestions, and progress. 


These classes are specifically for test prep before the examination.    
I suggest students enroll in this class several weeks to 1 month before the examination.


My FCE & IELTS courses are comprehensive and tailored to meet your specific needs, whether you're focusing on Speaking, Writing, Reading, or Listening, - we’ll design the course to suit your goals. 

 
The IELTS test emphasizes several key areas:  

- Identifying and paraphrasing keywords to understand questions and texts effectively  
- Managing your time efficiently to complete tasks within the given limits  
- Fully addressing task requirements to achieve high marks in task achievement  
- Structuring your answers logically with clear coherence and cohesion  
- Using a wide range of grammar accurately and appropriately  
- Expanding your vocabulary with topic-specific words while avoiding repetition  
- Developing active listening strategies to identify specific information and predict answers  
- Improving pronunciation for clear and natural communication  
- Enhancing fluency through effective use of stress and intonation  
- Building confidence with mock tests that replicate real test conditions


The FCE test emphasizes several key areas:  

- Expanding vocabulary and mastering grammar, including collocations, phrasal verbs, and word formation  
- Paraphrasing sentences effectively to demonstrate flexibility in language use  
- Identifying key details and main ideas for articles, reports, and advertisements  
- Writing structured and coherent essays, letters, reviews, and reports that suit the task  
- Managing time efficiently to complete tasks
